budget_items.topic: Possible additional funding from new growth (Chair's Report)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chair reported a possible $40,000 from new growth, and a $230,000 addition the Town Manager had mentioned, which the Town Manager then told the district not to count on.
budget_items.quote: there was a chance of maybe $40,000 from additional new growth but nothing definite.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $230,000 addition to the school budget was reported as stated at the Select Board, pending new growth certification and a warrant article.
budget_items.quote: there would be an addition $230,000 added to the school budget pending new growth certification
